area: Incidents record view, new-incident intake panel, workflow tree

heuristicIssues.issue: A field worker must hand-type latitude and longitude to six decimals; there is no 'use my location' (navigator.geolocation) and no map pick, so a first-day reporter on a phone cannot complete the required fields without an external app.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/features/incidents/IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:83-104 (two type=number inputs, no geolocation or map affordance); required check at IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:165-167
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add a 'Use my location' button that fills both fields from navigator.geolocation (with accuracy shown) and a compact map picker (the ArcGIS map already exists in Mission Center); keep manual entry as a fallback.

heuristicIssues.issue: The 'record view' never shows the record: description, first_observed_at, current_stage, incident_key, office_code, reporter, created_at, resolved_at and resolution_comment exist on Incident but only six table columns render, so 'Open incident record' deep links land on a row with less information than the source page.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:274-326 renders id/title/classification/location/status/assignment/assessment only; web/src/api/types.ts:243-277 lists the unrendered fields
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Give /incidents/:id a real detail surface (expandable row on desktop, full page on phone) that renders description, timestamps, stage, reporter, attachments and the workflow tree.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'No assessment' is shown for every row to non-operational users even when an assessment exists, because assessments are only fetched when isOperationalUser is true; on the intake tab the text is always true and therefore noise.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render the Assessment column only for operational users; for reporters replace it with a 'Submission' column or hide it. On the intake tab render '—' or drop the column.

heuristicIssues.issue: Three dismiss controls (header Cancel, footer Cancel, toolbar 'Close report') all discard a half-typed report with no confirm-discard and no draft retention.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:53-60 and :169-176 (duplicate Cancel), IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:239-241 (toggle) all call resetCreateIncidentForm at :139-144 which wipes form and files
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep one Cancel; if the form is dirty, ask 'Discard this report?' before resetting; persist a draft in sessionStorage so an accidental navigation does not lose the entry.

heuristicIssues.issue: When one or more attachment uploads fail after the incident is created, the panel has already been reset, the notice truncates to two failures, and this page offers no way to re-attach the files to the new incident.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep failed files in a 'Retry upload' list bound to the created incident id; list every failure; only reset once all uploads succeed or the user dismisses.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: Validation is imperative and page-level: no required/aria-invalid attributes, no field-level messages, the error renders in the shared page banner outside the panel, and the same banner is reused for list-load failures. Cancel does not clear it, so a stale validation message persists after the panel closes.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:163-167 (setError with generic strings), :271 (banner rendered after the panel and tab banner), :139-144 (resetCreateIncidentForm never calls setError(null)); IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:68-126 (no required/aria-invalid)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Wrap the panel in <form onSubmit>, add required + aria-invalid + aria-describedby per field, show inline messages next to the offending field, focus the first invalid field, and clear form errors on cancel; keep a separate error state for list loading.

heuristicIssues.issue: The 'Event Group #id' row link is shown to every role, but the target is RoleRoute-gated to operational users, so maintenance-only reporters are bounced to /submissions (a page with no nav entry for them) with no explanation.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:304 renders the link unconditionally; gating per inventory (App.tsx:69-76, auth/RoleRoute.tsx:19)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Only render the Event Group link when isOperationalUser; for reporters show the Event Group id as plain text or link to the Mission Center map view they can open.

heuristicIssues.issue: WorkflowTreeModal/WorkflowTreeView and getWorkflowTree are never mounted or called, so no screen shows where an incident sits in the review chain or who owns it; users only get the terse status badge and assignee name.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/components/WorkflowTree.tsx:77,110 and web/src/api/workflowTree.ts:71-73 are exported but IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx imports neither (imports at :1-24)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Mount WorkflowTreeView inside the incident detail surface as a 'Progress' section (or delete the dead code if the feature is abandoned).

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Loading classification…' is a permanent state for any incident the classification endpoint returns no row for, because items and classifications are set together in load().
heuristicIssues.evidence: incidentClassification.ts:19 returns the loading string whenever classification is undefined; IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:81-88 sets both in one pass
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Track a classificationsLoaded flag; once loaded, render 'Classification unavailable' (muted) instead of a loading message.

heuristicIssues.issue: The count 'X of Y incidents' uses the per-tab filtered count for X and the total across both tabs for Y, so the intake tab reads '3 of 40'.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Denominate against the current tab (records: items.length - intakeCount; intake: intakeCount) and word it 'Showing 3 of 5 awaiting intake'.

heuristicIssues.issue: A deep link to an unknown id, or to an id hidden by the status/unclaimed filter, produces no feedback; the page silently shows the unfiltered default tab.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:104-106 (return early if target missing), :116-130 (filters can hide the target)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: If highlightId is set and not found after load, show 'Incident #n not found'; if found but filtered out, clear the filters or show 'Incident #n is hidden by your filters — show it'.

heuristicIssues.issue: While on /incidents/:id, pressing Refresh or switching tabs and then refreshing forces the tab back to the target's tab, because the highlight effect re-runs on every items change.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:103-112 depends on [highlightId, items] and calls setTab unconditionally
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Run the tab switch and scroll once per highlightId (ref flag) rather than on every items change.

heuristicIssues.issue: Creating an incident and uploading N attachments sequentially shows only 'Creating…' with no per-file progress, and the Refresh button in the toolbar also flips to 'Refreshing…' because it shares the busy flag.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Separate loading, creating and uploading flags; show 'Uploading 2 of 4…' and per-file state in the pending list.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: NEW status is styled with the --bad (red) token, so the intake tab is a wall of red badges that read as errors rather than newly filed reports.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use a neutral or brand tint for NEW, amber for IN_PROGRESS, green for RESOLVED; reserve --bad for genuine failure states.

heuristicIssues.issue: Vocabulary drift on one screen: the filter says 'Unclaimed only' while the column says 'Unassigned'; the tab says 'Awaiting intake', the banner says 'review', My Work and the workflow tree say 'triage'.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Pick one term per concept (Unassigned; Intake) and apply it across the filter, column, banner, My Work and PATH_LABEL.

heuristicIssues.issue: Links are colour-only with underline on hover, so on touch devices and for colour-blind users nothing distinguishes 'View on map', 'AS #12' and 'Sub #4' from plain text.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Underline links by default or render row actions as small bordered chips/buttons with an icon.

heuristicIssues.issue: Search matches description, district and post mile, none of which are displayed as such, so a row can match with no visible reason; the placeholder also omits that id and post mile are searchable.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:124 (fields searched) vs :300-309 (fields rendered); placeholder at :225
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show a one-line description excerpt under the title (or a 'matched in description' hint when the needle only hits description) and update the placeholder to 'Search id, title, location or description'.

heuristicIssues.issue: The tab switcher is two plain buttons: selection is conveyed by background colour only, with no role=tablist/tab, aria-selected or keyboard arrow navigation; the search input and status select have no accessible label.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use role=tablist/tab with aria-selected and aria-controls, add aria-label to the search and status select, and add a visible 'Status' label or floating label.

heuristicIssues.issue: There is no /incidents/new route, no autoFocus on Title, and no 'Now' shortcut for First observed, so the primary mobile task cannot be deep-linked from My Work or a home-screen bookmark and always starts with two extra taps.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:238-259 (panel toggled by local state only); IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:69 (no autoFocus), :76-78 (datetime-local with no default)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add /incidents/new that opens the panel (or a dedicated page), autoFocus Title, default First observed to now with a 'Now' button.

heuristicIssues.issue: formatCoordinate on blur silently replaces a non-numeric or out-of-range entry with an empty string, so a typo disappears without explanation.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep the raw text, mark the field invalid with a message ('Latitude must be between -90 and 90'), and only normalise when the value parses.

heuristicIssues.issue: Every visit and Refresh fetches up to 1000 incidents, a classification query for every id, and 1000 assessments, then filters client-side with no pagination, sorting or column ordering; anything past 1000 is silently truncated.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Push search/status/stage filters and paging to the API, add sortable column headers, and show 'Showing 1–50 of 312'.

heuristicIssues.issue: An explanatory banner is shown permanently on every visit under the toolbar, consuming a full row (two to three lines on phones) after the first read.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Make the banner dismissible (remember in localStorage) or reduce it to an info icon with a tooltip/popover next to the tab label.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Raw codes leak into the UI: assessment state (e.g. PENDING_OFFICE_DELEGATION) and event_type are rendered verbatim although a shared assessmentStateLabel helper exists; the attachment kind enum (PHOTO/DOC) is likewise shown raw in the intake panel.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Map every enum through a label helper before rendering; hide event_type from users entirely.

heuristicIssues.issue: The tree uses a hard-coded dark-tuned Tailwind palette (emerald-300, sky-200, amber-200, red-200/300, slate-500/600, text-black dots, fixed rgba shadow) while every other surface in the area uses --brand/--good/--bad tokens, so contrast breaks on the light and coastal themes.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Rebuild STATUS classes on the color-mix token pattern used in incidentUiModel.ts:63-71 and use ring/shadow tokens.

heuristicIssues.issue: The 'Classification: Unclassified · assigned after field assessment' box repeats the sentence in the helper paragraph directly above it; the footer Cancel duplicates the header Cancel.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Delete the info box and the header Cancel.

heuristicIssues.issue: Required fields are marked with a bare ' *' and no legend, no native required attribute, and no accept filter or type hint on the file input beyond helper text; the 'Supporting files' label is not associated with the input.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add '* required' legend, required attributes, htmlFor/id on the file label, and accept='image/*,video/*,.pdf,.dwg,.dxf'.

heuristicIssues.issue: Unicode status glyphs (⮌ ► ■ ○ ↺) are font-dependent and not aria-hidden so screen readers announce them before the label; every node card body is a focusable <button> even when hasDetail is false; linked incident/location ids are plain text rather than links.
heuristicIssues.evidence: WorkflowTree.tsx:11-19,52 (glyphs), :47-50 (button regardless of hasDetail), :64-65,:92-96 (ids as text)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use aria-hidden SVG icons, render a plain div when there is nothing to expand, and link ids to /incidents/:id.

heuristicIssues.issue: The ID column duplicates the fallback title 'Incident #id' and raw six-decimal coordinates occupy the first line of every Location cell although the D/County/Route/PM label is what people read.
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:300,302 (id twice when title is blank), :307 (formatCoordinate pair)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Fold the id into the title cell as a muted prefix and move coordinates to a tooltip/detail view.

heuristicIssues.issue: Primary, secondary and small buttons are repeated as literal class strings with differing padding and radius, and three separate pill implementations exist (IncidentStatusBadge, AssessmentStateBadge mini, WorkflowTree STATUS).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Introduce Button and Badge primitives in web/src/ui and use them in all three files.

responsiveIssues.issue: Six-column table has no min-width, column priority or card fallback; at 375px each column gets roughly 55px, so Incident and Location cells wrap into 5–6 line stacks or the overflow-x-auto wrapper scrolls with Assessment/Submission off-screen.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md render each incident as a card (title, status badge, location label, one action row); at md–lg hide ID and coordinates with 'hidden lg:table-cell'; add 'min-w-[720px]' to the table at lg+ so it scrolls instead of crushing.

responsiveIssues.issue: The toolbar wraps into four or five rows: nowrap tab pair (~300px with counts), search on its own row (min-w-[220px]), select + checkbox + count, then the New incident/Refresh group, pushing the list one screen down.
responsiveIssues.evidence: IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:220-244 ('flex flex-wrap', whitespace-nowrap at :211, min-w-[220px] at :225, ml-auto at :237)
responsiveIssues.fix: Stack: tabs full-width as a segmented control, search full-width, filters behind a 'Filters (1)' disclosure button, and make 'New incident' a sticky bottom action on phones.

responsiveIssues.issue: Touch targets are under 44px: native checkbox (~13px), AS#/Sub# links at 11–12px text, tab buttons and inputs at ~36px; links show no non-hover affordance on touch.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use min-h-11 on tabs, inputs and select; replace the checkbox with a toggle chip; render row links as 44px-tall chips with icons and permanent underline.

responsiveIssues.issue: Deep-link scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) fires after 150ms; the sticky AppShell header can overlap the top of the row on short viewports and the highlight is inline style only.
responsiveIssues.fix: Add 'scroll-mt-24' to rows (or compute the header height) and mark the row with aria-current='true'.

responsiveIssues.issue: A single column of ten fields plus the files block is roughly 2.5 screens tall; 'Create incident' is at the bottom and validation errors render in the page banner after the panel and after the tab banner, so the error can be off-screen from the field it refers to.
responsiveIssues.evidence: IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:67-185 (grid then files then footer); IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:247-271 (panel, then tab banner, then error)
responsiveIssues.fix: Split into steps (What / When / Where / Evidence) or collapse optional location text fields under 'More location details'; make the footer sticky (position:sticky bottom-0) and show inline field errors.

responsiveIssues.issue: type=number with inputMode=decimal often hides the minus key on iOS numeric keypads, yet every California longitude is negative; there is no camera capture attribute and no thumbnails for chosen photos.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use type='text' inputMode='decimal' with a pattern and explicit validation; add a second 'Take photo' input with capture='environment' and accept='image/*'; render image thumbnails in the pending list.

responsiveIssues.issue: 'Remove' buttons on pending files are about 26px tall, below the 44px minimum, and sit next to a truncated name so a mis-tap removes the wrong file.
responsiveIssues.fix: Make Remove a 44px icon button with aria-label='Remove {file name}' and give the file row min-h-12.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768px the md two-column grid pairs Title with the min-h-20 Description textarea, producing an uneven first row that pushes the required First observed field below the fold in landscape; datetime-local inputs on iPadOS can exceed the cell because inputClass sets no width constraint.
responsiveIssues.fix: Add 'w-full min-w-0' to inputClass; make Description span both columns at md (md:col-span-2) so Title sits alone on row one and dates pair on row two.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768 portrait the inline nav card renders above content (sidebar only at lg), and the six-column table gets ~120px per column, so Incident and Location cells wrap three to four lines each; at 1024 landscape the w-64 sidebar appears and leaves ~760px for the same six columns, so the crunch persists.
responsiveIssues.fix: Hide ID and coordinates below xl, merge Assignment into the Status cell as a second line, and default the sidebar to the w-16 rail below xl.

responsiveIssues.issue: The toolbar wraps to two rows and the ml-auto New incident/Refresh group jumps to the second line, separating the primary action from the tabs.
responsiveIssues.fix: Put tabs and the action group on row one (justify-between) and search/filters on row two at all widths below xl.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1440px the xl three-column grid leaves a blank spacer cell in row two and splits the location fields across two rows (Lat | Lon | District, County | Route | Post mile), so the Caltrans location group reads as unrelated inputs.
responsiveIssues.fix: Group Latitude/Longitude and District/County/Route/Post mile in a <fieldset> 'Location' with its own 4-column sub-grid and drop the spacer.

responsiveIssues.issue: A vertical stack of four to six cards plus connectors exceeds the viewport; the overlay scrolls while body scroll is locked, mt-10 plus p-4 wastes ~56px above the title, the summary bar wraps to three or four lines, and 'Close' is ~30px tall.
responsiveIssues.evidence: WorkflowTree.tsx:98-105 (flex-col below xl), :127-128 (mt-10, p-4), :82-90 (flex-wrap summary), :132 ('px-3 py-1 text-sm')
responsiveIssues.fix: Render as a full-screen sheet below md (mt-0, min-h-dvh), put the summary in a two-line header, make Close 44px, and collapse completed steps by default.

responsiveIssues.issue: The tree stays a vertical list below xl (1280px) even on a 1024px landscape tablet where four or five 180px cards would fit side by side.
responsiveIssues.fix: Switch to lg: or use a container query on the modal panel; layout the node list as 'grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr))]'.

responsiveIssues.issue: At >=1280px flex-1 cards stretch unevenly when a row wraps, and the current-node ring uses a fixed rgba(31,94,255,0.25) shadow that ignores the theme.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use the auto-fit grid above so cards share equal width, and express the shadow with color-mix on --brand.

responsiveIssues.issue: Every button, badge and link relies on hover states (hover:bg, hover:underline, hover:brightness-95) with no focus-visible ring, so keyboard and touch users get weaker affordances than mouse users.
responsiveIssues.fix: Add 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--brand)]' to the shared Button primitive and permanent underline to links.

dataDensity.element: Tab labels with live counts (Incident records / Awaiting intake)
dataDensity.reason: Orients every role and doubles as the intake backlog indicator; primary way to find a report (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:222-223).
Useful for filter feedback but currently misleading; fix the denominator and move it to the table header row (:236).
First-visit orientation only; show once, then behind an info icon (:261-269).
Essential, but split into a list-load error and inline form errors (:271).
Tells the reporter what happens next; make it dismissible (:272).
Needed for cross-referencing but a column is expensive; render as a muted prefix in the Incident cell (:300).
Primary identifier a human scans for (:302).
What kind of incident; essential for operational triage (:38,:303).

dataDensity.element: Classification state line ('Pending assessment review' / 'Confirmed from approved assessment')
dataDensity.reason: Redundant with the AssessmentStateBadge in the last column; fold into the badge tooltip (:39).
Becomes a permanent lie when no row is returned; replace with a loaded-aware fallback (incidentClassification.ts:19).
Container the incident was accepted into; gate to operational users (:304).
Raw numbers nobody scans; show in the detail view or on hover, keep the D/County/Route/PM label (:307).
Caltrans-native vocabulary; the location a dispatcher recognises (:308).
Primary onward action for spatial context; render as an icon chip (:309).
Core state; recolour NEW away from red (:311).
Essential for coordinators, irrelevant for reporters; merge under the Status badge as a second line and hide below lg (:312).
Operational roles need the assessment hop; hide the column for non-operational users (:315).
Always shown for non-operational users and always true on intake tab; render '—' or nothing (:316).
Secondary hop; show in the detail view or as a count chip '2 submissions' (:317-319).
Only cue that the deep link worked; add aria-current and a 'clear' affordance (:292,:298).
Essential; add a 'Clear filters' action (:288).
Primary lookup tool; fix the placeholder (:225).
Core filter; give it a visible label (:226-231).
Coordinator-only concern; show it only for operational users, behind the Filters disclosure on phones (:232-235).
Lists should refresh on focus/interval; keep as a small icon button (:243).
Primary action for reporting roles; make it sticky on phones (:238-242).
Sets the 'unclassified until assessment' expectation once (IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:48-51).
Repeats the paragraph above it (:63-65).
Duplicate of footer Cancel (:53-60).
Required fields that define the report (:68,:76,:83,:94).
Primary free-text evidence; give it more room on phones (:72-74).
Optional and often unknown in the field; show under 'Add when it occurred' (:79-81).
Optional and derivable from coordinates; collapse under 'Location details' with auto-fill from the map/geolocation (:105-126).
Photos are the field worker's main evidence; add capture and thumbnails (:130-139).
Confirms what will upload; humanise the kind enum (:143-151).
Dead field never rendered or posted (incidentUiModel.ts:5,19).
Dialog heading and aria-labelledby target (WorkflowTree.tsx:131).

dataDensity.element: Overall status pill + Path label + Current owner
dataDensity.reason: Answers 'where is it and who is it waiting on' (:83-88).
Secondary; humanise the state and move into the assessment node card (:89).
Important exception state; make ids links (:92-96).

dataDensity.element: Node card: role, step label, status, person, completed_at
dataDensity.reason: The core of the visualisation (:44-59).

dataDensity.element: Node details: actor email, notes, linked ids
dataDensity.reason: Already behind a Details toggle; keep that pattern (:60-67).
Internal enum with no user meaning (:66).
Typed but never rendered (api/workflowTree.ts:40).

quickWins: Fix the result count denominator to the current tab and reword to 'Showing X of Y awaiting intake' (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:236).
Replace 'Loading classification…' with a loaded-aware 'Classification unavailable' fallback (incidentClassification.ts:19; pass a loaded flag from IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:88).
Hide the Assessment column and 'No assessment' text for non-operational users and on the intake tab (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:283,313-316).
Recolour NEW to brand/neutral and IN_PROGRESS to amber (incidentUiModel.ts:64-70).
Rename 'Unclaimed only' to 'Unassigned only' and align tab/banner wording to 'intake' (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:234,263).
Add role=tablist/tab + aria-selected to the tab buttons and aria-label to the search input and status select (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:207-231).
Make links always underlined and add focus-visible rings (drop 'hover:' prefix at :263,267,304,309,315,318).
Gate the 'Event Group #id' link on isOperationalUser; show plain text for reporters (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:304).
Add 'scroll-mt-24' to rows and aria-current on the highlighted row; run the deep-link tab switch once per id (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:103-112,296-298).

Wrap IncidentCreatePanel in <form onSubmit>, add required/aria-invalid, autoFocus Title, and clear error in resetCreateIncidentForm (IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:44-69; IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:139-144).
Add a 'Use my location' button (navigator.geolocation) beside Latitude/Longitude and a 'Now' button beside First observed (IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:76-104).
Add accept and capture='environment' to the file input, humanise kind labels, and make Remove a 44px icon button (IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:131-160).
Delete the duplicate Classification info box and header Cancel (IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:53-60,63-65) and the dead incident_type field (incidentUiModel.ts:5,19).
Split the shared busy flag into loading/creating so Refresh and the form do not disable each other (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:68,76,169,243,251).
Make the explanatory banners dismissible with a localStorage flag (IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:261-269).
Add 'w-full min-w-0' to inputClass and 'hidden lg:table-cell' to the ID and coordinate cells (IncidentCreatePanel.tsx:18; IncidentsOperationsPage.tsx:278,300,307).
Retheme WorkflowTree STATUS classes onto --good/--brand/--bad color-mix tokens and aria-hide the glyphs (WorkflowTree.tsx:11-19,52).
structuralChanges: Give /incidents/:id a real incident record page: header (title, id, incident_key, stage, status), description, first observed/occurred, location with mini map, reporter and timestamps, attachments, assessment/submission links, and the mounted WorkflowTreeView as a 'Progress' section; the table becomes the index and the deep link becomes a page instead of a highlighted row.

Create a dedicated /incidents/new mobile-first intake flow (What / When / Where with geolocation + map pick / Evidence with camera capture), sticky footer, inline validation, draft persistence and retryable uploads; link it from My Work, the nav and the Incidents toolbar.

Make the list responsive by design: table with column priority at lg+ (hide ID/coordinates/Assignment progressively), card list below lg, and a filter bar that collapses to search + 'Filters' popover on phones with the primary action sticky.
Move search, stage/status filters, sorting and pagination server-side; drop the three 1000-row fetches and add sortable headers and 'Showing 1–50 of N'.

Unify the four overlapping state vocabularies (status, current_stage, classification_status, assessment state) into a single 'Stage' column with one Badge primitive and one colour mapping, and extract Button/Input/Badge primitives into web/src/ui used by Incidents, the intake panel and the workflow tree.

Add a mobile navigation drawer to AppShell so field workers on phones and portrait tablets do not scroll past the full nav card to reach the Incidents toolbar (cross-cutting; ui/AppShell.tsx:164 per inventory).
